This mother and her daughter are minor characters in ''[[Pokémon: Path to the Peak]]''.

==History==
In ''[[PTP03|Internationals]]'', they were first seen when they met [[Ava]] at the hotel the night before the championships started. According to the mother, her daughter watched Ava's videos numerous times and became a huge fan of Ava. When Ava was trying to rebuild her deck with the help of Joshua and [[Celestine]], the daughter decided to deliver the last missing card to complete the deck, a {{TCG|Darkrai}}.

They were seen again watching the finals of the international championship, when Ava lost, the daughter began to cry for her idol's defeat.

In ''[[PTP04|Worlds]]'', the daughter was seen watching Ava's rematch with [[Edgar Troy]], when Ava became [[Champion]], she was seen celebrating her idol's victory with {{TCG|Darkrai}}.

==Deck==
The daughter uses a {{e|Grass}} deck, focused on {{TCG|Oddish}}. Her deck is based on the main deck used by [[Ava]] in the series.
